PRAGMA cache_size = 5;
    WITH r(x,y) AS (
      SELECT 1, randomblob(100)
      UNION ALL
      SELECT x+1, randomblob(100) FROM r
      LIMIT 100000
    )
    SELECT count(x), length(y) FROM r GROUP BY (x%5)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX i1 ON t1(b, a);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX i2 ON t1(a);
